messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: High p95 latency spike detected for /prompt-route-new (prod us-west-2). 5xxs up 3.2x, p95 -> 480ms. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/route-stats

emma (oncall): I'm on it. Paging @raj and @mia. CS FYI @cs-sarah

raj (eng-runtime): seeing correlated KV cache miss rate increase and a tail on worker-42 logs. New darklaunch routing to /prompt-new-v2 started at 2012345600. Suspect model variant differences causing longer tokenization + decode time. Recommend flip feature flag to stable route immediately.

mia (eng-sre): standing by. Preparing to flip flag and watch autoscaler. Logging into infra now.

raj (eng-runtime): if flip, also set routing fallback to legacy for 1m to drain in-flight requests.

mia (eng-sre): executing flag toggle now:
```bash
redwood-ff toggle darklaunch_prompt_route --env prod --value false --actor mia --reason "p95 spike"
```

mia (eng-sre): toggle command returned OK. Feature flag darklaunch_prompt_route -> OFF (applied across 6 regions). Confirming controllers are receiving config.

incident-bot: Feature flag 'darklaunch_prompt_route' toggled to OFF by mia at 2012345710. Auto-check: 6/6 controllers OK.

emma (oncall): Observability update: p95 decreased from 480ms -> 130ms within 50s of toggle. 5xxs trending back to baseline. https://dash.redwood.ai/d/route-stats?from=2012345600

leo (product): Thanks. Any customers impacted or errors surfaced to CS?

cs-sarah: We received two Priority 2 tickets from AcmeCorp and FinWave complaining about slow responses since ~2012345620. I've opened a customer incident and notified their CSMs. I'll send a short status note once we confirm stability.

raj (eng-runtime): root cause hypothesis: tokenizer change in the v2 endpoint produced 20-30% longer decoding time for common prefixes, plus KV-cache warm-up penalty because route shards weren't warmed. Need a short postmortem and coordination on disabling the darklaunch packaging until we have perf parity tests.

mia (eng-sre): created temporary safety rule to prevent darklaunch route from rolling again for 24h: `ff:freeze darklaunch_prompt_route --until 24h`

emma (oncall): good. Action items: 1) Keep flag off and freeze rollout 2) Run perf regression suite against v2 in staging with representative prefixes 3) PR to add tokenization tests + canary runbook 4) CS follow-up to affected customers. I'll assign owners in the incident tracker.

leo (product): I'll own the communication and coordinate with model team for perf regressions.

raj (eng-runtime): I'll dig into worker-42 logs and KV-cache heuristics; will follow up with a reproducible perf test by EOD.

mia (eng-sre): I'll monitor for any reappearance and verify autoscaler behavior. Setting an alert to page if p95 > 250ms for 5m.

cs-sarah: Draft status note ready, will publish to status.redwood.ai if no rebound in 30m. I also messaged the two customers directly.

emma (oncall): thanks team. Handing off oncall to @alex for overnight monitoring; Alex pls ack and take the paging runbook.

alex (oncall): ack — taking handoff. I'll watch the p95 and error-rate channels and escalate if anything trips. :thumbsup:

emma (oncall): closing this live thread — mitigation applied (flag off), customers notified, next steps tracked. We'll open a postmortem with timeline and tests tomorrow.
